experiment: E62 induction_cue, Amendment 4: the old-copying mask test. Does the fine-tune's mask at the marker open the subcomponents W0's own mask opens when W0 copies, and does the masked gain run through them? On E62's saved step-30 states.
spec: reports/plans/2026-11-02_plan_regating-next-FABLE-DRAFT.md, option 1, approved by the user ('yes run the free test'). Departures are listed under departures_from_the_draft below
stands_beside: results/predictions.json, predictions_amend2.json and predictions_amend3.json are not edited. copy_not_elicitation (r not scored), mask_reaches_b_another_way and head_more_than_target stand as filed.
claim: On the copying map, the fine-tune's mask at the marker opens the subcomponents W0's own mask opens when W0 copies, and the masked gain runs through them; on the lookup it does not.
null: The copying state's mask opens subcomponents unrelated to W0's copying subcomponents, no more aligned than chance and no more than the lookup's; closing W0's copying subcomponents costs the masked gain no more than closing as many random opened subcomponents.
granularity_limit: A new circuit built from old subcomponents reads as elicited to VPD. shared_pieces says the state's mask opens the subcomponents W0's copying opens and the gain runs through them, at the level of VPD's rank-one subcomponents; it cannot say the same circuit is reused rather than a new circuit of those subcomponents, and the head label is at the level of heads.

settings.from_predictions_json: half, n_boot: results/predictions.json settings, read at run time
settings.windows: the 200 read windows of results/large/windows.pt, per map; the first 41 columns are the same for both maps (checked at load), so W0's one Γ pass serves both
settings.means: results/large/heads.pt: W0's target-model means, as Amendments 2 and 3
settings.precision: Γ and the masked forward bf16 (autocast on CUDA, compute_ci and masked_logits), target model fp32, allow_tf32 off, batch 64, on the L40: the same as Amendment 3. Masked reads and target reads are therefore on two precisions; the control's within-2 bar compares across them, as Amendments 2 and 3 did

definitions.gates: Γ's per-subcomponent, per-position values on the 200 read windows, alive subcomponents only, 9,881 across the 24 matrices, ci_len 41; every mean is over windows. The alive vector lists matrices in sorted name order, subcomponents in index order
definitions.a: W0's mean gate at the second A (half - 1) on the intact windows minus W0's mean gate at the second A on the pair-broken windows (copying.broken_pair, amend2.py's, control_seed 62): what W0's mask adds because a copy is available. Two Γ passes, no head off. The same key at the same position in both; checked on the real windows.pt and again at run time
definitions.S_old: copying.s_old(a): the fewest subcomponents holding half of a's positive mass, largest first, ties in index order, reaching exactly half counts; its size is k
definitions.delta: the state's mean gate at the marker minus W0's mean gate at the marker
definitions.alignment: cosine(delta, a); chance = the same cosine with a's entries permuted over the alive set, mean over 20 seeded draws, sd printed
definitions.closing: the state's gates with S_old's set to W0's values at every position, in the masked forward, original subcomponents, Delta out, every head on
definitions.closing_share: 1 - (masked gain under closing) / (masked gain L01 - L00), both net of the same L00, per window; copying.share_lost, copying.share_sd for the row sd
definitions.random_reference: the median over 5 seeded draws of k subcomponents closed the same way, drawn from those the state opened at the marker (delta > 0) outside S_old; if fewer than k, from all alive outside S_old, printed as pool_fell_back
definitions.a_half2: The earlier definition, reported beside with no rule: W0's mean gate at half - 1 minus at half - 2, intact windows
definitions.W0_closing: At the second A, on the intact tokens: S_old's gates set to their per-window pair-broken values at every position, in the masked forward. Share of the masked lean lost, 1 - (closed - masked pair-broken) / (masked intact - masked pair-broken). Random sets: 5 seeded draws of k from the entries with a > 0 outside S_old (fallback as random_reference), closed the same way
definitions.masked_lean: Masked log-odds of B at the second A, W0's own mask on the intact windows, minus W0's own mask on the pair-broken windows; the target's lean is the same without masks

thresholds.p_b_source: 10 x W0's geometric-mean P(B) at the marker on these 200 windows, 3.154e-4 (run.json stage_b.prior_copy), measured the same way (exp mean log P). The draft's 4.3e-4 is job 48507's, on the filtered windows Amendment 1 dropped. A tie passes
thresholds.target_fall_source: W0's own fall under (2,4) at the marker, amend2.json row4_w0_fall, 1.16277 on the copying map. The draft expected the fall at the second A to be over it; here a miss is also a stop (departures). A tie passes
thresholds.masked_source: The draft's 2 and 0.25, chosen there, no published source; 2 is now on the lean, not the level (review M1). Ties pass
thresholds.min_gain_source: local_faith.MIN_GAIN, read on L01 - L00, any state under it reads too_small. Measured 13.79 to 13.85 copying map, 5.72 to 6.38 lookup, amend3.json
thresholds.align_source: Chosen in the draft, no source. Ties pass except lookup_align_frac, where the lookup must be under
thresholds.margin_source: E58's band gap, as E62's r_gap
thresholds.reread_source: Measured floor 0: Amendment 3 re-read L00 and L01 from amend2.json in another job on the L40 with differences of exactly 0 (amend3.json diff_a2, all six states and both maps), and stage 2 makes the same calls on the same windows. 0.001 is the brief's stop and Amendment 3's other_card_tol: it is 7e-5 of a share at a gain of 13.8, so it cannot change a reading. Printed as max_diff and exact; a difference that is not 0 on the L40 is a thing to look at even under the stop
thresholds.zero_source: Measured: Amendment 3's zero update's masked gain read exactly 0 per map (amend3.json zero_gain_max_abs)
thresholds.lean_source: W0's target-model lean at the marker on these windows, amend2.json row4_w0_fall lean_target.on, 1.5801. This is the run-time confirmation that W0 loses the copy when the pair is broken: at the second A it is unread until the job runs, so a miss stops before a is used. A tie passes

predictions.stage1_control: First and alone, W0 at the second A, target B. Before any forward copying.second_a_holds and copying.pair_broken_holds on the windows. copying.second_a_control, in order. About the target model (control_failed_target): P(B) (geometric mean) at least p_b_min, else no_copying; the fall under (2,4) at least target_fall_min, else head_not_carrying; the lean (intact minus pair-broken) at least lean_min, else no_pair_dependence. About the mask (control_failed_mask): masked lean within 2 of the target's, else mask_lean_off; masked fall under (2,4), off in the forward only, at least 0.25 of the target's, else mask_drops_head. Levels are printed, no bar. A miss exits 1. k = 0 or k over half the alive set (4,940) exits 1 as unreadable. Expected: k tens to a few hundred; a's mass is unmeasured, so k could read larger.
predictions.P1_alignment: Copying map cosine >= 0.2 and >= 3 x its chance on all three seeds; lookup under half of the copying map's, same seed, on every seed.
predictions.P2_closing: Copying map's closing share >= 0.5 and above its random median by >= 0.24 on every seed; lookup's <= 0.2, same seed, on every seed. A negative share misses on the copying map and holds the bar on the lookup.
predictions.P3_gap: Copying minus lookup closing share >= 0.24, same seed, on every seed. P2 implies P3 (0.5 - 0.2 > 0.24): P3 is reported and decides no verdict; it says only whether a P2 miss still shows a gap.
predictions.verdict: copying.mask_test, first that fires: unreadable (the control's numbers not finite); control_failed_target; control_failed_mask; unreadable (k = 0, k over half the alive set, a seed missing, a gain not finite); too_small (any gain under min_gain); unreadable (any other number not finite); old_pieces_not_carrying (stage 2 missed); shared_pieces (P1, P2, P3 on every seed); then the null, copying map alone, either arm on every seed: (a) share - random_median under 0.24 and (cosine under 0.2 or under 3 x chance); (b) share at or under random_median. It reads not_shared if largest_k_share is at least 0.5 on every seed, else k_too_small. in_between is anything else. The same dict shape on a stop and on a finished run.
predictions.reported_no_rule: (2,3)'s target share per state, no expected value: W0's second prefix head, whose slot opens as far as (2,4)'s. all_alive_share per state: every alive subcomponent closed, expected about 1, up to what non-alive gates carry; well under 1 goes beside any P2 miss. largest_outside_share: the k largest openings outside S_old; the closing share above it is the claim 'these rather than others'. largest_overlap: how many of the k largest are in S_old. cos_positive: the cosine of the positive parts, expected near the cosine or under it, as shared closings do not count. half2_cos, half2_share, half2_k, half2_overlap, cos_a_half2: the half - 2 contrast, no expected value but that its closing should fall more on the lookup, as it holds key-reading subcomponents. old_opened, n_opened, pool_size, chance_sd, share_sd, random_shares.
predictions.stage2_carries: copying.old_carries: W0's closing share at the second A at least 0.5 and above its random median by at least 0.24, P2's bars. A miss is no stop: the states are read and reported, and the verdict is old_pieces_not_carrying. A masked lean at or under 0 makes the share nan, a miss. all_alive_share reported beside, no rule.
predictions.stage3_reread: L00 per map and L01 - L00 per state equal amend3.json within reread_tol, expected exactly 0 on the L40. The zero update's masked gain, and its level under closing, read exactly L00 per map. A miss exits 1.
predictions.largest_k_share_in_the_rule: The closing share of the k largest openings, expected at or over the closing share, gates not_shared and nothing else (review H3).

expected_at_the_references.W0: Alignment undefined (delta = 0), closing share at the marker undefined (no gain). Target at the second A: P(B) at least ten times the marker's, fall over 1.16, lean over 1.58. Masked lean within 2 of it, fall at least a quarter of it. W0's closing at the second A at least 0.5 and 0.24 over random; every alive closed at or over that, and under 1 by what the token change alone carries through the masked forward.
expected_at_the_references.do_nothing: Zero update: gain exactly 0, closing share 0/0, reported as the level L00 under closing, exactly L00. Alignment undefined.
expected_at_the_references.control: Chance about 0 +- 0.01 by permutation; random median 0.05 to 0.2, with most of the pool's opened subcomponents barely open, so it is a weak reference (plan, Blind to). Copying map: gain 13.8, cosine at least 0.2, lean 0.3 to 0.5, closing share at least 0.5. Lookup: gain 5.7 to 6.4, cosine under half the copying map's, closing share at most 0.2.

departures_from_the_draft: not_shared is written in the null's terms, copying map only (review H3, replacing the first fix of 56c6981): share no more than random by the margin and alignment no more than chance, or share at or under random. A cosine of 0.19 with share 0.49 against random 0.02 now reads in_between.
'At or under its random median' is read on every seed, as the other arm of the same branch is. The draft did not say.
The random pool excludes S_old throughout. As written, a mask opening exactly S_old drew S_old as its own reference and read not_shared.
P(B)'s bar is 10 x 3.154e-4, the read windows' value, not 10 x 4.3e-4, the value on windows Amendment 1 dropped.
A target fall under 1.1628 stops the run. The draft had it as expected only, and with a fall near 0 the quarter bar passes with nothing to test.
largest_k_share gates not_shared: below 0.5 on any seed the branch reads k_too_small (review H3).
a is the pair-broken contrast at the second A, not half - 1 minus half - 2, which is reported beside (review H2).
New check and verdict: S_old must carry W0's own copying, or old_pieces_not_carrying blocks shared_pieces and not_shared (review H1).

The within-2 bar is on the lean, not the level (review M1), and control_failed is split by cause (review L1): the draft's fallback for no_copying, repeated sequences for a, has no code; that case goes to the user.
edge_cases: tests/test_copying.py, all pure but one forward on a tiny real ComponentModel, run before filing. a with no positive mass, or not finite: k = 0, unreadable. S_old disjoint from the opened set: closing changes the marker gates nothing, share 0, not_shared at a random median of 0 or more; at a negative median, not_shared if the alignment also misses, else in_between. A negative closing share: a miss on the copying map, not_shared if it is at or under the median, or no more than the median by the margin with the alignment also missing, else in_between; on the lookup it holds the bar. Ties in a's ordering: index order, stable, and reaching exactly half counts. Fewer than k opened subcomponents: every alive subcomponent outside S_old, printed. An empty pool: unreachable, as k <= half the alive set leaves at least k outside S_old; random_sets asserts. A zero or negative gain: too_small before any share is read (the share is nan by share_lost). A zero-norm delta: cosine nan, unreadable. Non-finite anything: unreadable. A seed missing: unreadable. Negative chance: the 0.2 bar decides. Control: a zero or negative target fall is head_not_carrying, so the quarter bar's denominator is positive; ties pass. Every combination of P1, P2, P3 reaches exactly one verdict: the branches are one chain with in_between last, and the two combinations with P2 and not P3 cannot occur. Added after the review: the review's H3 table as tests; a grid of cosine, share, median, lookup, largest_k_share and carries against the rule written out apart from the code; old_pieces_not_carrying over would-be shared_pieces and would-be not_shared; a masked lean at or under 0 reads a miss on stage 2; a pair-broken window edited elsewhere or with the second A moved is refused.
amended_before_any_run: Filed 2026-11-02 at 56c6981; amended the same day after the code review, reports/reviews/2026-11-02_review_e62-amend4-code.md (d04b2af), findings H1, H2, H3, M1, M2, M3, L1, L2. Nothing had run. Why: S_old had no test that it carries W0's copying; a mostly separated a key token from a plain token, so copying subcomponents could be left out of S_old and not_shared would stop the line wrongly; not_shared fired on data that refutes the null; the within-2 level bar read an offset every other number nets out.
